name: ProvLevel-Reason
description: A build-provenance attestation is the document a consumer reads to decide whether an artifact was produced by a trustworthy build: it records who built it, from what sources, on what platform, and whether the record is signed. Adjudicating it means applying a laddered rubric, the SLSA build levels, to a structured in-toto/DSSE document. As language models increasingly become the readers of this metadata, the question is whether they apply that rubric or merely pattern-match on its surface.
